meta.parties: Dissanayake, L.A. v. Punchi Menikke, G.M

rules.statement: A binna marriage, once validated by registration, does not forfeit the inheritance rights of a daughter.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the reasons which I have given, the learned Judge was wrong in taking the view that Dingirimenika forfeited her paternal inheritance. The true position is that her conveyance P2 in favour of the plaintiff vested in him an undivided one-third share in the property, and that her outstanding one-sixth share passed to her son the 6th defendant by maternal inheritance."
